anonymization.accounts: Display labels use work-account/personal-account; identifier keys use work_account/personal_account.
anonymization.paths: Evidence paths are relative to the repository root; .. retains locations outside it. Historical commands anchor external paths at ${PWD}. Evidence was not copied or moved.
anonymization.history: Original timestamps, hashes, results and caveats are retained. Labels and paths are anonymized representations; historical verification does not attest to edited bytes or current live state.

outcome: 0.55.6 구현·로컬 설치 완료. 설치된 MindPlayer의 실제 Codex 입력 화면에서 동일 세션의 연속 3회 Jev 판단·요청·응답 완료를 확인했다.

source.versionSource: Cargo.toml / Cargo.lock; no environment-variable version override

installedBinary.scope: Exact installed executable; synthetic loopback Jev/native fixtures, new/resume/handoff and A→B→A selection. This is not real-model inference evidence.

regressions: Late tool-output acknowledgement cannot resurrect a completed turn or strand later user input.
Queued turn/start waits for completion; turn/steer and tool outputs do not reroute an active turn.
Disconnect, rejected start and stale judgment never cause automatic replay.
Status channel rejects wrong owner/generation, stale requests and helper-thread status; native pane geometry, context and usage remain intact.

actualInstalledNativeUi.account: Existing personal-account Codex login, same pane/account/provider throughout; no auth files copied or modified.
actualInstalledNativeUi.cleanup: Only the test Codex UI and its owning MindPlayer were exited normally. Pane status directory was removed by normal cleanup. Existing user sessions were not interrupted; the new test transcript remains available.
actualInstalledNativeUi.auxiliaryHarness: Two auxiliary API-only verification attempts stopped before judgment/inference (unsupported untrusted config and startup notification handling). Their unused helper was removed; no success claim is based on them. Actual native-UI evidence above is independent.

simplifications: Reuse the native composer, model row and pane border; no dashboard, picker, toggle, popup or second input surface.
Without an empirical policy, Jev chooses exact native catalog model+effort configurations directly; no hardcoded model tiers or fabricated evaluation/cost profiles.
Remove the redundant auxiliary verification helper; exercise the installed native UI and existing smoke path instead.
remainingLimits: Already-running binaries/panes retain their old embedded runtime. Start a new MindPlayer process and reopen the session to use this installation.

Selection uses native catalog descriptions, not measured quality or proven minimum subscription cost. All three real test prompts selected the same alternative; fixture tests separately verify A→B→A switching.
Codex start acceptance and completion do not attest physical serving-model identity. The UI explicitly shows unverified execution unless a matching server model report exists.
Active-turn queued input, interruptions and error states have automated protocol/renderer coverage, not an exhaustive authenticated native-UI run for every state.
Existing empirical policy remains authoritative; invalid policy fails closed. Missing key or Jev failure prevents submission rather than silently bypassing judgment.
The private metadata channel prevents accidental credential forwarding; mode 0600 is not isolation from other processes running as the same OS user.
